name: RG20268
tagline: Traditional cast iron artistry with advanced thermal efficiency
description: The Godin SM02 is a masterclass in classic European stove design, blending intricate cast iron craftsmanship with modern closed-combustion technology. Engineered for superior heat retention, its heavy-duty mineral ore construction allows for even heat distribution that persists long after the fire has dimmed. The iconic arched viewing window is kept clear by an integrated air-wash system, while precision dual air controls and a dedicated ash collection compartment make this stove as user-friendly as it is aesthetically timeless.
features: Durable full cast iron body for maximum thermal mass
Ornate arched ceramic glass door for a classic fire view
Dual primary and secondary air sliders for combustion control
Self-cleaning air-wash system for clear glass maintenance
Reinforced internal grate with easy-access ash pan
